messages:
Noah: Heads-up — vendor just updated ETAs for the FRA shipment, looks like a staggered wave: 30 H100s scheduled Mon 03:00 UTC, remaining 30 Wed 14:00 UTC. They mentioned customs split and an AWB swap. We should decide spare allocation and RMA path now.
Sana: Thanks. Do we want those 2 spare units we usually hold on top of committed? Capacity is tight for Dedicated pools next week.
Marco: Can we get AWBs and whether insurance covers DOA for split shipments? If forwarder changes, serials might not match depot manifest. Need photos on receipt.
Elle (Carrier): Confirming AWBs: `AWB: 2487 5566 9921` (Mon batch) and `AWB: 2487 5566 9922` (Wed batch). Insurance covers transit damage up to declared value; DOA process applies but partial-replace fee applies for cross-AWB claims.
Karen: Proposal: route Mon batch -> Depot FRA-A for priority QC and keep 2 spares queued at Depot FRA-B. Wed batch -> Depot FRA-A as normal. If DOA on Mon batch, route RMA to same AWB/forwarder to avoid manifest split.
Noah: OK. Sana, does holdback of 2 spares sound OK vs. sending all to Dedicated? We may need a temporary reserve for canary rollouts.
Sana: Hold 2 spares. We should also flag 6 units for Dedicated pool, rest to Hosted. I'll update allocation sheet.
Marco: Need vendor to add photos of palletization and serial manifest prior to handoff. If we don't get them, we'll refuse acceptance and trigger RMA.
Elle (Carrier): Can upload pre-pick photos to the portal by EOD. On the partial-replace fee: we can waive one-time fee if Redwood issues a commit for monthly top-off >= 200 units next quarter.
Noah: Noted. That's a negotiable lever. Sana, want to consider commit for credit?
Sana: I'll take to finance and ops — quick ballpark: a month at 200 units is big, but we can propose a 3-month ramp. Will report back by 12:00 PST.
Marco: For RMA workflow, can we consolidate claims under one depot RMA to reduce broker fees? If AWBs are separate that may be tricky.
Karen: We'll prioritize QC on Mon batch; create single RMA queue but track AWB mapping per serial. That should cut duplicate broker handling.
Noah: Please create RMA ticket and assign tentative priority. Use `create-rma --batch 1767743210 --hold 2 --priority high` for the Mon batch.
RMA-Bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-8912. Status: draft -> assigned Marco. Includes fields: `awb_mon=248755669921`, `awb_wed=248755669922`, `hold_spares=2`.
Marco: I'll pick up RMA-8912 and coordinate depot photos + manifest reconciliation. ETA for manifest reconcile < 6 hours after arrival.
Elle (Carrier): Upload scheduled. If customs causes >48h delay on Wed batch we can offer a temporary loaner (4 units) for 48-72h at no additional cost while claims process.
Noah: Great. Can we get that in writing (email) for ops to reference?
Elle (Carrier): Will follow up with email and attach proof terms by EOD.
Sana: I'll delay the Dedicated assignment until we get the photos and email confirmation. If vendor waives partial-replace fee we can approve spares hold.
Karen: Quick checklist for arrival: 1) depot photos, 2) serial manifest compare, 3) QC boot test (10% sample), 4) if fail -> RMA-8912 escalation.
Noah: :thumbsup: Good plan. If anything changes (customs or AWB swap) ping this thread and @Marco.
Marco: Copy. Standing by to reconcile on arrival.
